name: artifact
description: Create or edit deliverable files in the WebUI Artifact workspace via patch (*** Begin Patch / *** End Patch). Paths are plain artifact file names. Use for reports, documents, and standalone files the user should inspect, not routine source edits. Publish an existing local file with present_artifact; read entries with read using artifact: paths. HTML entries run their scripts in a sandboxed frame that has no network access. Charts and interactive pages work with ECharts at /vendor/echarts/echarts.min.js, KaTeX at /vendor/katex/katex.min.js, Prism at /vendor/prism/prism.min.js. External CDNs, fetch, and remote images are blocked.

patchText.description: Full patch text wrapped in *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch.
